title: give the Check's focused test command as one command per test, so read-only roles can run it without a regex alternation

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261125-185405-f675, project ork, item S531:

give the Check's focused test command as one command per test, so read-only roles can run it without a regex alternation

Evidence: go test -run 'TestSweepMissing|TestScrollSweep' was denied as "multiple operations"; ran two separate commands instead (same as S523/S571)
